answer: Weight each vote by the square root of its locked bond and publish every bond receipt to a summit registry, where a shared audit prism links wallets that trace back to one backer. Splitting a treasury across a thousand keys cannot multiply influence, since roots of small stakes never sum to the root of one large stake. A double vote is slashable once proof is shown, so any observer can seize the offender's bond. A pigment-stained farm of Sybils must therefore lock real capital for every node and loses all of it the moment the audit finds the link.
